div.head: V Atr 32.1
div.ab: Ðæt is þonne án ærest æt ðam ætfengan, þe swicigende manswican lufedan be westan, þe mænigne man geswæncton ⁊ on unriht gedrehtan.
Ðæt is þonne án ærest æt ðam ætfengan, þe swicigende manswican lufedan be westan, þe mænigne man geswænctan ⁊ on unriht gedrehtan.
Ðæt is þonne án ærest æt ðam ætfengan þe swicigende manswican lufedan be westan, þe mænigne man geswænctan ⁊ on unriht gedrehtan.
Ðæt is þonne an ærest æt ðam ætfengan, þe swicigen manswican lufedan be westan, þe mænigne man geswænctan and on unriht gedrehtan.
Das ist nämlich zuerst eines in den Anefang-Processen, das arglistige Betrüger im Westen gerne thaten, welche manchen Mann belästigten und unrechtmässig bedrängten.
Namely, the first is one in suits of attachment, which deceitful frauds in the west liked to commit, who harassed many a man and oppressed him unjustly.
Firstly, with regard to the process of attaching property, to which crafty rogues in the west have been much addicted and by which many people have been harassed and unjustly oppressed.
First of all, concerning the property seizures loved by lying swindlers in the west, which have distressed and wrongfully afflicted many people.
div.note: 32.1–32.5 survive only in D; K now gives D's text from Gesetze I p. 244 (it previously held a placeholder). Liebermann compares II Atr 9.; AU: corrected against Rabin p. 156 / 157, October 2026 (was “Đæt”, now “Ðæt”); AY: added from Rabin p. 156 / 157, October 2026 (Rabin’s note to the text)
32.1–5: These clauses are found only in D.
in the west: It is unknown what Wulfstan is referring to here and in his reference to “the north” in 32.4.

note.seg: Vgl. Wb: mannswica.—In folg. Z. lies: ‘gar manchen M., viele Leute’
Cf. Wb: mannswica.—In the following line read: ‘full many a m., many people’
The allusions to the west and the north (§ 4) are obscure. For the latter Liebermann refers to Be Griðe, 13; 13, 2.
